description: Bounded authoritative publication case for current Activ One capacity ordering semantics.

decision_reasons: The current policy wording directly establishes the Base Sum Insured -> Super Credit -> Super Reload -> Cancer Booster utilization sequence.
The generic ordered-capacity evaluator derives bounded next-capacity and fail-closed traversal consequences without product-specific branching.
The certification explicitly excludes claim-payment, admissibility, and unrelated cost-sharing or benefit-stacking mechanics.

authoritative_publication.publication_authority: Phase 2 governed authoritative bounded-capacity-ordering publication authority

guardrails: This publication is limited to ordered capacity traversal for the current Activ One source.
It does not calculate claim payment, payable amount, or overall claim admissibility.
It does not assert optional Super Credit or Cancer Booster applicability when unresolved.
It does not establish copay, deductible, waiting-period, or arbitrary benefit-stacking order.
A selected next capacity is not a guarantee of payment or entitlement.
